claims.text: Riociguat: soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator (nitric oxide pathway);
claims.quote: Riociguat, a soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator, also acts via the nitric oxide pathway.
claims.locator: Treatment of Pulmonary Hypertension › Pulmonary arterial hypertension, Group 1

claims.text: ↑6-min walk distance, ↓PVR and improved functional class, alone or added to an ERA or prostacyclin analog;
claims.quote: In the PATENT-1 trial, riociguat increased 6-minute walk distance, decreased pulmonary vascular resistance, and improved functional class when used as sequential combination therapy in patients receiving an endothelin-receptor antagonist or prostacyclin analog (as well as when used as monotherapy)
claims.locator: Treatment of Pulmonary Hypertension › Pulmonary arterial hypertension, Group 1

claims.text: CTEPH not a surgical candidate: ↑exercise capacity and ↓PVR.
claims.quote: Riociguat has improved exercise capacity and pulmonary vascular resistance in patients who are not surgical candidates or for whom the risk to benefit ratio is too high
claims.locator: Treatment of Pulmonary Hypertension › Pulmonary hypertension, groups 2 to 5

claims.text: Never combine riociguat w a PDE-5 inhibitor: both ↑cGMP, risk of dangerous hypotension.
claims.quote: However, phosphodiesterase 5 inhibitors cannot be combined with riociguat (a soluble guanylate cyclase stimulant) because both medication classes increase cyclic guanosine monophosphate (cGMP) levels, and the combination can lead to dangerous hypotension.
claims.locator: Treatment of Pulmonary Hypertension › Pulmonary arterial hypertension, Group 1

claims.quote: The activin receptor signaling pathway has recently been implicated in pulmonary hypertension and is targeted by sotatercept, an activin signaling inhibitor.
claims.locator: Treatment of Pulmonary Hypertension › Pulmonary arterial hypertension, Group 1

claims.text: added to standard background tx it improved the 6-min walk test at 24 wk (phase 3).
claims.quote: In a phase 3 trial of sotatercept or placebo added to standard of care background therapy, patients who received sotatercept demonstrated significant improvement in the 6-minute walk test at 24 weeks.
claims.locator: Treatment of Pulmonary Hypertension › Pulmonary arterial hypertension, Group 1

claims.text: Lung disease w hypoxia: supplemental O2 plus tx of the primary disorder.
claims.quote: Patients with lung disorders and hypoxia benefit from supplemental oxygen as well as treatment of the primary disorder.
claims.locator: Treatment of Pulmonary Hypertension › Pulmonary hypertension, groups 2 to 5
